comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
***Extra Information***

Tech Rank: 1
Consumed Gauge: 20
Range: 100
Shatter Range: 45

Requires 2 seconds before the activation.
With advanture job it requires just one second before the activation.

Effect:
No effects, it will only deal damage. Higher Trap increases the damage out-put. Further more, adding this to your original Tech may add blind-effect + increases the shatter range of the original Tech.
